senses.sense_definition: The physical or logical arrangement of nodes and connections in a communications network.

examples.text: The network <w>topology</w> was redesigned to improve data transfer speeds between the servers.

target_lang_translations.zh: 为了提高服务器之间的数据传输速度，网络<w>拓扑</w>被重新设计了。

examples.text: Engineers must choose the right <w>topology</w> to ensure the system remains reliable during high traffic.

target_lang_translations.zh: 工程师必须选择正确的<w>拓扑</w>，以确保系统在高流量下依然可靠。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 通信网络中节点和连接的物理或逻辑布局。

senses.sense_definition: A branch of mathematics studying properties of geometric objects that remain unchanged by continuous deformations.

examples.text: Students in the advanced course learned how <w>topology</w> classifies shapes based on their holes.

target_lang_translations.zh: 高级课程的学生学习了<w>拓扑学</w>如何根据孔洞来分类形状。

examples.text: Modern <w>topology</w> provides essential tools for understanding complex spaces in theoretical physics.

target_lang_translations.zh: 现代<w>拓扑学</w>为理解理论物理中的复杂空间提供了重要工具。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 数学的一个分支，研究几何对象在连续变形下保持不变的性质。

senses.sense_definition: A collection of subsets of a set that satisfies specific rules regarding intersections and unions.

examples.text: The standard <w>topology</w> on the real line is generated by all open intervals.

target_lang_translations.zh: 实数轴上的标准<w>拓扑</w>是由所有开区间生成的。

examples.text: Defining a <w>topology</w> on a set allows mathematicians to discuss concepts like continuity and convergence.

target_lang_translations.zh: 在集合上定义一种<w>拓扑</w>，使数学家能够讨论连续性和收敛性等概念。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 集合论中满足特定交集和并集规则的子集集合。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 数学集合论中的拓扑结构

senses.sense_definition: The anatomical structure or arrangement of parts within a body.

examples.text: The <w>topology</w> of the human brain is incredibly complex and still not fully understood.

target_lang_translations.zh: 人脑的解剖<w>结构</w>极其复杂，目前尚未被完全理解。

examples.text: Researchers mapped the <w>topology</w> of the nervous system to identify potential pathways for injury.

target_lang_translations.zh: 研究人员绘制了神经系统的<w>结构</w>图，以确定潜在的损伤路径。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 生物体内部器官或组织的解剖结构或排列方式。

senses.sense_definition: The essential properties of a technological system that remain constant regardless of its physical layout.

examples.text: The software <w>topology</w> remains consistent even when the hardware components are upgraded.

target_lang_translations.zh: 即使在硬件组件升级时，软件<w>拓扑</w>依然保持一致。

examples.text: We analyzed the system <w>topology</w> to ensure the logic would function across different platforms.

target_lang_translations.zh: 我们分析了系统<w>拓扑</w>，以确保其逻辑能在不同平台上运行。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 技术系统在物理布局改变时仍保持不变的核心逻辑属性。

senses.sense_definition: The study of geographic locations in relation to their historical context.

examples.text: The historian examined the <w>topology</w> of the ancient city to understand its defensive strategies.

target_lang_translations.zh: 历史学家考察了这座古城的<w>地理布局</w>，以了解其防御策略。

examples.text: Local <w>topology</w> reveals how the landscape influenced the development of early trade routes.

target_lang_translations.zh: 当地的<w>地理布局</w>揭示了地形如何影响早期贸易路线的发展。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 研究地理位置及其历史背景之间关系的学科。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指历史地理中的空间分布

senses.sense_definition: A mnemonic method of remembering information by associating it with specific physical locations.

examples.text: He used a mental <w>topology</w> to memorize the long list of names for his presentation.

target_lang_translations.zh: 他利用一种<w>位置记忆法</w>记住了演讲所需的一长串名字。

examples.text: The ancient art of <w>topology</w> helps speakers recall complex arguments without using notes.

target_lang_translations.zh: 这种古老的<w>位置记忆法</w>能帮助演讲者在不看笔记的情况下回忆起复杂的论点。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种通过将信息与特定物理位置相关联来记忆信息的助记方法。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指记忆宫殿或空间联想法
